name: CreateVpc

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
VPC所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The CIDR block of the VPC.

We recommend that you use an IPv4 address specified in RFC 1918 as the primary IPv4 CIDR block of the VPC. The subnet mask must be 16 to 28 bits in length. Examples: 10.0.0.0/16, 172.16.0.0/16, and 192.168.0.0/16.
You can also use a custom CIDR block other than 100.64.0.0/10, 224.0.0.0/4, 127.0.0.0/8, 169.254.0.0/16, or their subnets as the primary IPv4 CIDR block of the virtual private cloud (VPC)
parameters.help_zh:
VPC的网段。

建议您使用RFC 1918标准中指定的私有IPv4地址作为VPC的主IPv4网段，网段掩码推荐使用16~28位。例如：10.0.0.0/16、172.16.0.0/16、192.168.0.0/16。
您也可以使用除100.64.0.0/10、224.0.0.0/4、127.0.0.0/8或169.254.0.0/16及其子网外的自定义地址段作为专有网络的主IPv4网段
parameters.name: cidr_block

parameters.help_en: The IPv6 CIDR block of the VPC. When you enable IPv6 for the VPC, the system will assign an IPv6 CIDR block. To specify an IPv6 CIDR block, you need to first invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448916.html operation to reserve the specified IPv6 CIDR block, and then pass it in
parameters.help_zh: VPC的IPv6网段。为VPC开启IPv6时，系统将分配IPv6网段。如需指定IPv6网段，您需要先调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448916.html接口预留指定的IPv6地址段，并将其传入
parameters.name: ipv6_cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The name of the VPC.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
VPC的名称。

长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: vpc_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable IPv6. Valid values:

false (default): disabled.
true: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启IPv6。取值：

false（默认值）：不开启。
true：开启
parameters.name: enable_ipv6

parameters.help_en:
The description of the VPC.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
VPC的描述信息。

长度为1～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2381067.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2381067.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without creating the VPC. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a Normal request and sends the request. If the request passes the check, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the system proceeds to create a VPC
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建VPC。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接创建VPC
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The user CIDR block. Separate multiple CIDR blocks with commas (,). You can specify up to three CIDR blocks.

For more information about user CIDR blocks, see the `What is a user CIDR block?` section in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185311.html
parameters.help_zh:
用户网段，如需定义多个网段请使用半角逗号（,）隔开，最多支持3个网段。

关于用户网段的详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185311.html的0
parameters.name: user_cidr

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The type of the IPv6 CIDR block of the VPC. Valid values:

BGP (default): Alibaba Cloud BGP IPv6.
ChinaMobile: China Mobile (single ISP).
ChinaUnicom: China Unicom (single ISP).
ChinaTelecom: China Telecom (single ISP).

If your account is included in the China single-ISP bandwidth whitelist, you can set this parameter to ChinaTelecom (China Telecom), ChinaUnicom (China Unicom), or ChinaMobile (China Mobile)
parameters.help_zh:
VPC的IPv6地址段类型。取值：

BGP（默认值）：阿里云BGP IPv6。
ChinaMobile：中国移动（单线）。
ChinaUnicom：中国联通（单线）。
ChinaTelecom：中国电信（单线）。

如果是开通了单线带宽白名单的用户，该字段可以设置为ChinaTelecom（中国电信）、ChinaUnicom（中国联通）或ChinaMobile（中国移动）
parameters.name: ipv6_isp

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the IPv4 IPAM pool
parameters.name: ipv4_ipam_pool_id

parameters.help_en:
The subnet mask used to allocate a CIDR block from the IPAM pool to the VPC.

When you create a VPC by specifying an IPAM pool, you must specify at least one of CidrBlock or Ipv4CidrMask
parameters.help_zh:
通过输入掩码的方式从IPAM地址池分配VPC。

指定IPAM地址池创建VPC时，参数CidrBlock或Ipv4CidrMask至少输入一个
parameters.name: ipv4_cidr_mask

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the DNS hostname feature. Valid values:

false (default): disabled.
true: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用DNS主机名功能。取值：

false（默认值）：不开启。
true：开启
parameters.name: enable_dns_hostname

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the IPv6 IPAM pool
parameters.name: ipv6_ipam_pool_id

parameters.help_en: The subnet mask used to add an IPv6 CIDR block to the VPC from the IPAM pool
parameters.help_zh: 通过输入掩码的方式从IPAM地址池为VPC添加IPv6网段
parameters.name: ipv6_cidr_mask
